svg.title: Concept preview of AmkyawDev TTS Studio mobile home screen
svg.desc: A dark navy glass phone mockup showing a Burmese script input, Piper, Gemini, VieNeu and GGUF engine choices, a voice profile, a Generate Speech button and recent audio. This is an original concept illustration, not a screenshot.
svg.text: Piper VITS · ONNX Runtime · no network
Long scripts are chunked automatically. One generation at a time.
